name: victory_3
text:
ART STYLE (the attached APPROVED-style-david-sheet.webp is the final look: match its cleanliness, pixel size, shading and outline EXACTLY; the other style image is only an early concept for mood):
- CLEAN, HIGH-QUALITY 2D pixel art for an arcade brawler, matching the APPROVED STYLE reference (codex/refs/style/APPROVED-style-david-sheet.webp) EXACTLY: a clean, polished, less-pixelated look with fine pixel blocks, smooth tidy edges, soft readable cel shading, crisp outlines. NOT chunky or blocky, NOT noisy, NO blur, NO painterly smoothing, NO 3D render look, NO gradients (use clean 3-4 tone cel shading and a bright rim light).
- Pixel size: fine and uniform, each visible pixel block about 4x4 px on the 1024x1024 canvas (a 256x256 logical grid). Keep the SAME pixel size in every image of every character so frames never mix pixel sizes. Clean lines, no stray single-pixel noise, no dithering clutter on faces.
- Detail level of the approved reference: clean expressive faces (eyes, brows, glasses glints, beard texture), readable fabric folds and seams, gold/teal trim lines, metallic highlights on gear. Same arcade proportions: slightly enlarged head, hands and boots.
- Dark navy outline #0B1026 (never pure black) around every shape, 1 pixel block thick, slightly thicker on the outer silhouette.
- Shading: 3 tones + 1 highlight per material, cel style. Key light warm from the top-left (#FFC857), cool TEAL rim light from the back-right (#2EE6D6).
- Vibrant but controlled palette (about 32 colours per character): TranTech navy #14213D / near-black polo #121B33, teal #19D3C5 and #2EE6D6, amber #FFA31A, warm gold #FFC857, electric blue #3EA6FF, LED green #4DFF88, cream #F6EAD2, skin tones with warm rosy mid-tones. Saturation about 15% higher than the concept image, never neon-garish.
- Brand: the uniform is a dark navy-black polo/top with the TranTech logo patch on the left chest: a small wide RECTANGLE with a teal outline and a tiny white word-mark (do not try to write legible text, a few pixels suggesting letters is right).

CHARACTER: ANNE-MAREE, "The Co-Boss" (Support / crowd control (co-owner, with David)). A stylised arcade-hero caricature of a REAL TranTech staff member, so the face and body must be recognisably THEM, flattering and fun.
REFERENCE PHOTO: attached as codex/refs/photos/annemaree.jpeg. Study it for face shape, hair, facial hair, glasses, skin tone, build and expression. Do not copy the photo's background or clothes literally; convert into the game style.
BUILD: full-figured, warm and powerful, taller-than-it-looks presence, slightly enlarged head/hands/boots.
LIKENESS (must be recognisable): SHORT CURLY DARK-BROWN HAIR with grey/silver highlights, voluminous curls framing the face. ROSE-PINK / CLEAR LIGHT-PINK FRAMED GLASSES (round-rectangular). Fair skin, rosy cheeks, huge warm LAUGHING open-mouth smile, bright hazel eyes. A thin gold chain necklace.
OUTFIT: TranTech BLACK short-sleeve draped cowl-neck top (NOT a polo: soft draped neckline) with the teal-outlined TranTech logo patch on the left chest, a tailored dark executive blazer worn open over the top with gold trim and a small TranTech lapel badge, black trousers, teal-soled ankle boots, a thin gold chain necklace.
SIGNATURE WEAPON: a golden executive GAVEL with a teal glowing head, and a floating glowing "EXECUTIVE CLIPBOARD" shield that orbits her arm.
FX COLOURS: #FF6FB1 pink + #FFC857 gold + #2EE6D6 teal.
PERSONALITY / SIGNATURE QUIRK (this is what makes them unique, show it in the design and every pose): Anne-Maree is DAVID'S WIFE and also THE BOSS (co-owner of TranTech). Warm, funny and fully in charge: an executive with a huge laugh. Authority, but kind.
EXTRA DETAIL: a small pen tucked in the curls; a gold nameplate pin that reads "BOSS".

SPRITE OUTPUT RULES (the image is imported by a script, so these are not optional):
1. Canvas exactly 1024x1024, background ONE flat solid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Nothing else in the background: no floor, no cast shadow, no glow, no gradient, no border, no text, no labels, no pose number, no watermark. The character must contain NO magenta, hot pink or purple-pink pixels (the keying colour).
2. ONE pose only. One character only. No turnaround, no collage, no second figure.
3. The character FACES RIGHT (towards the right edge of the canvas).
4. Scale: the standing/idle height is about 640 px tall (see per-character note) on this 1024 canvas: use the SAME scale in every frame of this character, never zoom per pose. Feet (soles) rest on the horizontal line y=960 whenever the pose is grounded; the body centre (the hips) sits on the vertical line x=512. In air poses keep the same centre and scale.
5. Keep the whole figure and all weapons/hair fully inside the canvas with at least 40 px free on every side.
6. Do not draw attack effects, trails, projectiles, impact bursts, motion lines, dust or shadows in the character image: those are separate images (fx_*). The only exceptions are the tiny sparkles/stars that the pose text explicitly asks for.
7. Likeness, outfit, proportions, colours, tattoos, glasses, hair and logo patch must be IDENTICAL to the approved design sheet and to the previous frames. If a frame disagrees with the sheet, the frame is wrong: regenerate it.

POSE TO DRAW (this single image only): VICTORY frame 3 of 3: holds the pose, a tiny sparkle on the teeth/glasses/weapon.

Move names for context: melee "Order In The Court", combo finisher "Final Decision", special "Performance Review", ultimate "Board Meeting". Melee = "Order In The Court": a gavel smash with a gold shockwave and a floating "ORDER!" exclamation. Special = "Performance Review": a laughing toss of a fan of glowing review forms that fly as spinning paper projectiles with gold star ratings (5 stars) and tiny sparkles. Ultimate = "Board Meeting": a long boardroom table crashes down from above with a ring of glowing executive chairs; Anne-Maree slams the gavel and a gold shockwave flings everyone off the table.

ART STYLE (the attached APPROVED-style-david-sheet.webp is the final look: match its cleanliness, pixel size, shading and outline EXACTLY; the other style image is only an early concept for mood):
- CLEAN, HIGH-QUALITY 2D pixel art for an arcade brawler, matching the APPROVED STYLE reference (codex/refs/style/APPROVED-style-david-sheet.webp) EXACTLY: a clean, polished, less-pixelated look with fine pixel blocks, smooth tidy edges, soft readable cel shading, crisp outlines. NOT chunky or blocky, NOT noisy, NO blur, NO painterly smoothing, NO 3D render look, NO gradients (use clean 3-4 tone cel shading and a bright rim light).
- Pixel size: fine and uniform, each visible pixel block about 4x4 px on the 1024x1024 canvas (a 256x256 logical grid). Keep the SAME pixel size in every image of every character so frames never mix pixel sizes. Clean lines, no stray single-pixel noise, no dithering clutter on faces.
- Detail level of the approved reference: clean expressive faces (eyes, brows, glasses glints, beard texture), readable fabric folds and seams, gold/teal trim lines, metallic highlights on gear. Same arcade proportions: slightly enlarged head, hands and boots.
- Dark navy outline #0B1026 (never pure black) around every shape, 1 pixel block thick, slightly thicker on the outer silhouette.
- Shading: 3 tones + 1 highlight per material, cel style. Key light warm from the top-left (#FFC857), cool TEAL rim light from the back-right (#2EE6D6).
- Vibrant but controlled palette (about 32 colours per character): TranTech navy #14213D / near-black polo #121B33, teal #19D3C5 and #2EE6D6, amber #FFA31A, warm gold #FFC857, electric blue #3EA6FF, LED green #4DFF88, cream #F6EAD2, skin tones with warm rosy mid-tones. Saturation about 15% higher than the concept image, never neon-garish.
- Brand: the uniform is a dark navy-black polo/top with the TranTech logo patch on the left chest: a small wide RECTANGLE with a teal outline and a tiny white word-mark (do not try to write legible text, a few pixels suggesting letters is right).

HERO CONTEXT: Bec "The Accounts Ace". Weapon: a big glowing CALCULATOR-shield (violet keys, teal screen showing numbers) and a long RECEIPT-TAPE WHIP that unspools glowing paper, with a rubber "PAID" stamp on a handle. FX colours: #B26BFF violet + #2EE6D6 teal. Melee: "Paid In Full": a stamp smash that bursts into a violet "PAID" ink splat and little coins. Special: "Invoice Barrage": a calm fan toss of glowing invoices that fly as spinning paper projectiles with gold dollar-sign sparkles and tiny numbers. Ultimate: "Payment Overdue": Bec slams a gigantic OVERDUE stamp down; a huge red stamp mark and a storm of coins, receipts and numbers explode across the stage.

EFFECT OUTPUT RULES:
1. Canvas exactly 1024x1024 (or the size stated), background ONE flat solid MAGENTA #FF00FF, nothing else in the background. The effect must contain NO magenta/hot pink pixels (use violet #9B5CFF or pink-orange #FF8A5C if you need pinks).
2. ONE frame of the animation per image, centred on the canvas; the effect's origin point (where the swing/impact/projectile is anchored) is at the exact centre x=512, y=512 so the frames line up when stacked.
3. The effect faces / travels to the RIGHT where it has direction.
4. Same pixel-art style as the character sprites (fine uniform 4x4 px pixel blocks, clean smooth shapes, navy outline where a shape needs it, bright white-hot cores, no blur). No characters in effect images.
5. Frames of one effect must keep the same scale, palette and origin, only the animation changes.

THIS IMAGE: frame 4 of 6. ULTIMATE EFFECT, part B (the detonation): 6 frames of the main blast of "Payment Overdue", huge and flashy, themed colours.

BUILD: full-figured, graceful and poised, slightly enlarged head/hands/boots.

FX COLOURS: #B26BFF violet + #2EE6D6 teal.
PERSONALITY / SIGNATURE QUIRK (this is what makes them unique, show it in the design and every pose): Bec is THE ACCOUNTS LADY: calm, precise, never misses a number. Invoices, receipts, stamps and calculators are her magic. A quiet powerhouse.
EXTRA DETAIL: a tiny floating sticky note that reads "INVOICE #1"; a pen behind the ear.

SPRITE OUTPUT RULES (the image is imported by a script, so these are not optional):
1. Canvas exactly 1024x1024, background ONE flat solid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Nothing else in the background: no floor, no cast shadow, no glow, no gradient, no border, no text, no labels, no pose number, no watermark. The character must contain NO magenta, hot pink or purple-pink pixels (the keying colour).
2. ONE pose only. One character only. No turnaround, no collage, no second figure.
3. The character FACES RIGHT (towards the right edge of the canvas).
4. Scale: the standing/idle height is about 640 px tall (see per-character note) on this 1024 canvas: use the SAME scale in every frame of this character, never zoom per pose. Feet (soles) rest on the horizontal line y=960 whenever the pose is grounded; the body centre (the hips) sits on the vertical line x=512. In air poses keep the same centre and scale.
5. Keep the whole figure and all weapons/hair fully inside the canvas with at least 40 px free on every side.
6. Do not draw attack effects, trails, projectiles, impact bursts, motion lines, dust or shadows in the character image: those are separate images (fx_*). The only exceptions are the tiny sparkles/stars that the pose text explicitly asks for.
7. Likeness, outfit, proportions, colours, tattoos, glasses, hair and logo patch must be IDENTICAL to the approved design sheet and to the previous frames. If a frame disagrees with the sheet, the frame is wrong: regenerate it.

POSE TO DRAW (this single image only): VICTORY frame 3 of 3: holds the pose, a tiny sparkle on the teeth/glasses/weapon.

Move names for context: melee "Paid In Full", combo finisher "Balance The Books", special "Invoice Barrage", ultimate "Payment Overdue". Melee = "Paid In Full": a stamp smash that bursts into a violet "PAID" ink splat and little coins. Special = "Invoice Barrage": a calm fan toss of glowing invoices that fly as spinning paper projectiles with gold dollar-sign sparkles and tiny numbers. Ultimate = "Payment Overdue": Bec slams a gigantic OVERDUE stamp down; a huge red stamp mark and a storm of coins, receipts and numbers explode across the stage.
